name: Mi Technovation Berhad
overview: 今年公司推进将 Mi Material Holding 分拆至新加坡交易所主板上市，并以实物股息方式向股东分派其股份；同时通过全资子公司 Ohima International 以 SGD103.88 million 收购新加坡一栋7层轻工业物业。最新一季营收同比增长29.9%，净利润同比增长84.8%。
overview_en: This year the company progressed the proposed listing of Mi Material Holding on the Mainboard of Singapore Exchange Securities Trading Limited and is distributing its shares to shareholders by way of dividend-in-specie; meanwhile, through wholly-owned subsidiary Ohima International, it is acquiring a 7-storey light industrial property in Singapore for SGD103.88 million. Latest quarter revenue rose 29.9% year-on-year and net profit rose 84.8% year-on-year.
